facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Grandmother had big ears. She had big eyes too. Something was not right. She felt something was wrong.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Red Riding Hood walked closer to the bed. She asked why Grandmother's ears were so big. She asked why Grandmother's eyes were so large. Each answer made her feel more and more worried. She felt something was wrong but did not know what. Her heart was beating faster with every question.
